STEP 1 - Vessel type: flat plate (rectangular/square-ish white plate with a rim band and flat centre, no inner wall visible).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square/rectangular plate, looks medium-large, roughly 22-26 cm across.
b) Reference: a chicken drumstick (11 cm) lies across the right side of the plate. The plate spans roughly 2.3 drumstick lengths across the short side (about 25 cm), so width ≈ 25 cm.
Reconciled width: about 25 cm (square area ≈ 625 cm²).

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Mixed salad greens (raw leafy, left half): covers roughly 40% of the plate (~250 cm²). Loose leaves, mounded to about 3 cm at the centre, averaging ~2 cm: 250 × 2 = 500 ml × 0.15 = 75 g. Add a little hidden greens/cherry tomatoes: ~80 g total.
- Cherry tomatoes: about 5 visible, plus about 2 hidden under leaves = 7 × 15 g = 105 g. Partly halved, so ~90 g.
- Chicken drumsticks: 2 pieces, roughly 90 g each, plus meat under the crumb topping: about 220 g total (cooked, skin on).
- Couscous/grain topping with herbs (right side, ~20% of plate ≈ 125 cm²): mound about 1.5 cm average, 3 cm at peak → 125 × 1.5 = 188 ml × 0.8 = 150 g.
- Green beans / chives (lower right, thin stalks, ~8% ≈ 50 cm², thin layer ~0.8 cm): 40 ml × 0.5 = 20 g (chopped vegetable density) ≈ 25 g.
- Dressing/oil sheen: small, ~5 g.

Total ≈ 80 + 90 + 220 + 150 + 25 + 5 = 570 g.

kcal per 100 g (as served):
- Mixed salad greens (raw): ~20 kcal
- Cherry tomatoes: ~18 kcal
- Chicken drumstick, roasted: ~190 kcal
- Couscous with herbs/oil: ~150 kcal
- Green beans/chives: ~30 kcal
- Dressing/oil: ~400 kcal

Rough energy: greens 16 + tomatoes 16 + chicken 418 + couscous 225 + beans 8 + dressing 20 ≈ 700 kcal.
